violation_type.title: Illness Preventing Care - Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.3601(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: During this investigation, it was determined the operation allowed a child to return to school without a doctor's note after being notified by the child's parent that the child had two communicable diseases (pink eye and hand, foot, and mouth) during different time frames.    Note: The child is no longer enrolled at the operation. The de-enrollment date was on 11/28/2022.

During the inspection it was found that children were allowed back into care before the were cleared from a physican to be present.
